description: Complete single-owner Laya integration across Local AI Hub: expose typed shadow decisions through the existing MCP and root-authorized HTTP surfaces; collect naturally occurring useful training examples with minimum necessary raw input where it materially helps, typed state, deterministic baselines, Laya outputs, downstream outcomes, provenance, scopes, redaction, lifecycle metrics, and failures; keep human labels separate with versioned rubric and independent review; support scoped review, deletion, group-safe validation/test splits, and safe verified export. Expose captured runtime-output history by bounded root-authorized cursor pages while keeping blind candidate get and human-label training export separate. Deterministic retrieval remains authoritative; advisory activates only after measured benefit and explicit approval. Keep inference local and shadow-only during collection. Do not train, benchmark, generate cards, run synthetic inference, download/install models, or roll out until separately authorized. Verify model/provider availability and live/runtime behavior; configured routes alone are not evidence. Approved specification path: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-10-laya-active-decision-service-training-capture.md.

acceptance_criteria: Category meets the approved quality gate with no necessary-fact loss and a measured benefit in reliability, quality, speed, or useful behavior.
Reference labels have local operator confirmation or separately attributed capable local-model review provenance; reviewer capability and evidence are recorded.
No insufficient-data result or unresolved provenance blocker.
Advisory remains opt-in and cannot trigger tools, task transitions, permissions, routing, or global automation.
Promotion to advisory requires separate explicit user approval.

task_laya_advisory.description: Expose typed advisory through an existing API/tool only after a registered decision category passes paired evaluation against deterministic behavior and receives explicit later approval. Callers cannot set mode, identity, permissions, or global automation. Result remains a proposal; errors and abstention preserve baseline. Reference labels may be operator-confirmed locally or carry separately attributed local-model review provenance; no remote reviewer keys or cloud fallback.
task_laya_advisory.next_action: Keep unregistered until genuine local examples are reviewed and the category passes evaluation.
task_laya_advisory.title: Expose explicit typed advisory call after validation

acceptance_criteria: Local review rejects unsuitable or duplicate examples and records useful cases with the versioned rubric.
Operator-confirmed labels and local-model reviews have distinct provenance; unreviewed/model-only cases stay out of human-confirmed training exports.
Unresolved, rejected, and test-split examples stay out of training exports.
Group provenance prevents related sessions from leaking across splits.
Training and benchmark remain unstarted until the user requests them after collection and review.
Future comparison uses the same held-out examples and records quality, latency, and compute separately.

An authorized root-scoped evaluate_snapshot operation compares Laya and deterministic suggestions on the same verified, human-labeled test examples; it returns aggregate-only metrics, validates snapshot/group/evidence provenance, excludes raw text and identifiers, and never activates advisory mode.
task_laya_evaluation.blocker: No authentic candidates or operator labels; paired evaluation, category promotion criteria and training outcomes remain unverified.
task_laya_evaluation.description: After authentic examples exist, locally reject unsuitable or duplicate examples and review useful cases under the versioned rubric. The operator may confirm a human training label; a capable local Codex/model may contribute a separately attributed model review. Record reviewer kind/model identity, rubric and evidence provenance locally. Model review cannot silently become a human-confirmed label or training export. No SSH keys, remote reviewer quorum, cloud fallback, synthetic data, training, or benchmark in this task.
task_laya_evaluation.next_action: After natural candidates are collected and operator labels exist, run the authorized local review and group-safe evaluation workflow; keep shadow authority and do not start training, benchmark or card generation.
task_laya_evaluation.title: Review natural candidates and prepare later paired evaluation

acceptance_criteria: Successful context retrievals with at least two authorized verified sources are eligible for both complete and incomplete coverage; invalid scope or evidence skips.
Automatic model-route, context-budget, delegation, next-step, redundant-step, completion-gap and watchdog decisions use authentic deterministic baselines and verified evidence IDs.
Natural capture targets thousands of useful unique candidates; report actual counts, duplicates, skips, queue states and failures.
Registered task identity is preserved; only an actual session may create an adhoc identity; foreign-root tasks fail closed.
Every admitted capture has a durable captured, skipped or failed terminal state; retries are bounded and idempotent; raw request content stays out of telemetry.
Laya remains shadow-only and cannot change routing, retrieval, permissions, task state, receipts or tool execution; review labels and export remain separate.
Verified completion pass/reject captures a typed next-step shadow decision with bounded acceptance and validation context; waiver skips inference; raw command output is excluded.
No synthetic inference, model installation, training, benchmark, advisory activation or data export.

acceptance_criteria: Use the existing always-available Hub Laya service, state directory, cache, candidate store, and one Hub-managed runtime per installation; create no separate daemon.
Hub startup keeps the Laya API/service available without eagerly loading the model; absence of a resident provider session is normal.

First eligible Laya request lazily loads the pinned local checkpoint and remains resident during active work and for 600 seconds after the latest completed request; each completion resets the idle deadline.
The presence or identity of another loaded model or GPU reservation alone never suppresses Laya request handling, blocks safe lazy load, or prevents Laya idle close.

Scheduler-owned physical capacity/coexistence checks remain authoritative; unknown or insufficient physical capacity and provider/device failures return explicit unavailable without evicting or preempting other models.
Preserve the active hardware profile, CPU fallback, reservation owner identity, and reservation limits.
Keep lifecycle safe across concurrent requests, timeout, idle expiry, reload, provider-close errors, and shutdown.
Verify checkpoint presence/hash and installed compatible provider before claiming runtime availability; configuration alone is insufficient.
Do not install/download models or drivers, change CPU fallback, run synthetic inference, train, benchmark, or roll out.
task_laya_foundation.blocker: A real local inference succeeded through torch.cuda on RTX 5070 Ti using the pinned checkpoint revision 1720e3e3357cfe1e281542e223f8273b0890ca34, with 5.25 s latency and candidate capture. The service later became unavailable; explicit service start restored Hub/Ollama. No Laya call has verified post-restart residency or the 600-second idle unload/reset behavior.
task_laya_foundation.description: Hub Laya API/service remains available for the lifetime of the Hub process, independent of whether a Laya model is resident. Do not preload at Hub startup. On the first Laya request, lazily load the explicitly pinned local checkpoint; retain the provider session while work is in flight and until 600 seconds after the most recently completed Laya request, resetting the idle deadline after every completion. Another model identity or external GPU reservation alone must not reject Laya, prevent its load, or prevent idle close. Stability source audit confirms dGPU admission uses an atomic capacity lease against fresh measured free VRAM; a valid external reservation alone is not a rejection, while unknown telemetry, invalid/foreign fence, stale reservation generation, and insufficient capacity fail closed. Stability reports 34 focused capacity/co-admission tests passed, including legacy reservation, owned scheduler digest, and fail-closed cases. Never evict, preempt, unload, or reconfigure another model; preserve reservation owner identity, limits, hardware profile, and CPU fallback.
task_laya_foundation.next_action: Keep lazy load; verify one subsequent real decision after the Hub restart only when justified by a natural task event, then verify runtime idle lifecycle without synthetic inference. Do not pull models or change GPU policy.
task_laya_foundation.title: Udržet Laya službu trvale dostupnou s lazy load
